thread:
elaine (SE): Quick sync re: FinCo POC — they have a few blockers around CMK/HSM. Can we confirm rotation policy options and cost delta for BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys? They need answers by EOD Friday.
matt (AE): +1. Who from security can confirm audit trail and exportability constraints?
ivan (security): We can't export private key material from our managed HSMs. For BYOK with customer HSM, they control rotation. For Redwood-managed CMK we support automatic rotation 30/90/365 days; rotation is a rekey operation, not exposing private key.
tara (FinCo): To clarify — we need HA replication across us-east-1 and eu-west-1 for keys. Is that supported with BYOK? Also any additional SLA impact?
ryan (infra): BYOK with external HSM federation -> we support key wrapping across regions but it's async replication; cross-region latency may affect cold-starts. SLA remains same for data plane but keys are eventually consistent. For Dedicated we can do synchronous replication with customer-supplied HSMs in AZs, needs SOW.
elaine (SE): Pricing note — BYOK onboarding is one-time $12k (setup + validation) + $500/mo key management fee. For Dedicated we list in the quote as 'BYOK premium' line item. I'll attach numbers to the deck.
tara (FinCo): Also the security questionnaire asks: 'Do you support HSM-backed BYOK with BYOK rotation initiated by customer?' Answer?
ivan (security): Yes — customers can rotate externally and we accept new wrapped key material via our import API. We validate via our key-import flow. Need to confirm allowed algorithms — we support RSA-2048/3072 and AES-256 symmetric keys. I'll follow up with exact cipher suite list.
matt (AE): Any blockers from legal re: key escrow / escrow prohibition? Customer wants no escrow.
elaine (SE): Legal said no escrow by default. We do not hold unwrapped customer private key material. We store wrapped keys, import metadata, and immutable audit logs.
ops-bot: POC checklist updated: BYOK validation scheduled Thu 14:00 UTC. Action owner: ryan.
ryan (infra): For the POC we'll need a short runbook: 1) generate key on customer HSM, 2) wrap with our import key, 3) call `/v1/keys/import`, 4) confirm usage. Sample request: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/import -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"wrapped_key":"...","alg":"AES-256"}'```
tara (FinCo): Nice. Is there a rollback plan if import fails during POC?
ryan (infra): Yes — keys are validated in sandbox first. If import fails, we keep the previous key material and revert routing. No data loss.
ivan (security): Need to add requirement: customer must provide HSM tamper and audit logs for compliance. Add to SOW.
elaine (SE): I'll update the SOW and pricing. Next steps: elaine to send updated SOW by Thu EOD, ivan to confirm algorithm/crypto list by Wed, ryan to prepare import runbook + test vector, matt to update quote. Tara will confirm replication/regional requirement.
tara (FinCo): Sounds good. Thanks all :thumbsup:
